detail.title: Gap Analysis in Normative Value Inquiry and Decision Theory
detail.summary: The commitment to evaluate the compatibility of decision theory frameworks with normative value inquiry remains open due to insufficient empirical evidence within the existing project corpus. Current research focuses on bridging this gap, as prior Popperian-focused critiques did not address decision-theoretic intersections. Research is initiated to clarify whether normative frameworks can be integrated into falsifiable empirical structures, prioritizing the mandate to complete due research.

children.title: decision theory frameworks bridging normative value inquiry

detail.reason: Existing evidence focuses on Popperian critique but lacks specific decision theory material necessary to resolve commit-values-004, which requires reviewing the bridge between decision theory and normative values.
